== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Slithers, also known as [[Othaghor]]’s Slithers, are mindless creatures created by [[Othaghor]]. These beasts function more like animals than other [[Elderspawn]], driven by the basic needs to eat and reproduce rather than following complex logic or cosmic plans. They are capable of attacking anyone indiscriminately, as they cannot distinguish between friends and enemies. Physically, the creatures are described as lime-green monstrosities with six yellow eyes and twelve webbed feet. They possess scarlet stingers and jaws that split horizontally when they strike. Their venom is highly dangerous; stings can cause wounds to swell, ooze pus and ichor, and lead to fatal seizures. Depending on their size and environment, they can be found in shallow waters—where larger versions may target boats—or emerging from grass, roots, and bark in forested areas.}}

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Slithers are small, mindless creatures that serve as the spawn of [[Othaghor]]. These entities possess unique jaws characterized by strange horizontal splits and are known to attack using stingers. In addition to their stingers, they bite their targets with teeth that carry a slow-acting [[poison]].}}
